description: Supply-constraint adjustments by manufacturing / raw-material tier. A second path-dependency in the same intellectual key as the reflexivity adjustment: just as sponsor capital structurally shapes trial design, a binding supply constraint (scarce isotopes, complex autologous manufacturing, limited fill-finish capacity) shapes BOTH trial throughput (a PoS risk) and the achievable commercial ceiling (a peak-sales haircut). Most rNPV tools price only the demand side of peak sales; the distinctive move here is to also price the supply side — you cannot sell what you cannot make.

primary_sources.citation: Asclepius framework dimension — supply-as-path-dependency; tiers are reasoned estimates anchored on the Ac-225 isotope-supply constraint and cell-therapy manufacturing precedent (no published cohort).
primary_sources.note: Honest provenance: these tiers are NOT derived from a published outcome cohort. They are reasoned estimates anchored on two well-documented real-world constraints (actinium-225 alpha-emitter scarcity; autologous cell-therapy manufacturing complexity).

adjustments.rationale: no binding supply constraint; standard manufacturing scales with demand.
